title: The Key
subtitle: A Suburban Journey Unveils Hidden Mysteries
summary: When famed detective Feluda and his companion embark on a quiet trip to the outskirts of Calcutta, their new acquaintance, Monimohan Samaddar, brings an unexpected twist to their journey. What begins as a leisurely escape quickly turns into a tangled web of secrets and intrigue, as Feluda’s sharp mind is drawn into a puzzle that only he can solve. Discover how ordinary moments can conceal extraordinary mysteries in this captivating detective adventure.
